CZ Asset Protocols (zařazení and vyřazení)

The protocol on putting a fixed asset into use and the protocol on its disposal, printed from the asset register of either Odoo edition.

Version19.0.1.0.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresl10n_cz
Extended byl10n_cz_asset_protocol_ee, l10n_cz_asset_protocol_oca

What it is for

Around every fixed asset a Czech accountant issues two internal documents:

  • Protokol o zařazení dlouhodobého majetku do užívání — the asset is put into use: its inventory number (inventární číslo), valuation (ocenění, usually the pořizovací cena), date, where it is kept and who is responsible for it;
  • Protokol o vyřazení dlouhodobého majetku — the asset leaves the books: why, how, and the figures at that moment.

This module adds the data a protocol needs that an asset register does not hold, and the two printouts. It works with whichever asset register is installed:

Edition Asset register Bridge (installs itself)
Community OCA account_asset_management l10n_cz_asset_protocol_oca — see Community
Enterprise Odoo account_asset l10n_cz_asset_protocol_ee — see Enterprise

Install this module; the matching bridge follows automatically. Without either register the module installs but shows nothing.

Legal background

Neither protocol has a prescribed form. Both are internal accounting documents (účetní doklady), and an accounting document must contain the particulars of § 11 odst. 1 of the Accounting Act:

  • a) the designation of the document,
  • b) the content of the transaction and its participants,
  • c) the amount, or the unit price and the quantity,
  • d) the moment the document was made out,
  • e) the moment of the transaction, where different from d),
  • f) the signature record of the person responsible for the transaction and the signature record of the person responsible for posting it.

The printouts carry the designation and the date the document was made out, the company with its seat and IČO, the asset and its figures, the date of putting into use or of disposal, and signature lines — including the two that letter f) asks for. What else the protocols contain is for your internal rules (vnitřní předpis); treat these templates as a starting point.

Three further sources shaped the content:

  • An asset becomes a fixed asset when it is brought into a condition fit for use (§ 7 odst. 11 of Decree No. 500/2002 Sb.); that is the date the commissioning protocol records. Depreciation follows a depreciation plan (§ 28 odst. 6 of the Accounting Act, § 56 odst. 4 of the decree), which is why the protocol names the plan.
  • Český účetní standard pro podnikatele č. 013 (Dlouhodobý nehmotný a hmotný majetek) lists the ways an asset is disposed of (bod 5.4) — the choices of Disposal method below — and defines the zůstatková cena as the valuation less oprávky (bod 4.4).
  • For tax purposes an asset is classified into a depreciation group (odpisová skupina) in its first year of depreciation and is depreciated straight-line or accelerated (§ 30 odst. 1 and 2 of the Income Taxes Act). Czech practice states both on the commissioning protocol; see Printing.

Recording the protocol data

Open an asset and go to the tab Protokoly (CZ):

Block Field Meaning
Zařazení Inventory number (inventární číslo) The number in your asset register. If left empty, the protocols print the register's own reference instead (see the bridges).
Location (místo umístění) Where the asset is kept.
Responsible person (odpovědná osoba) A contact.
Commissioning note (poznámka k zařazení) Technical condition, accessories, documents forming an annex.
Commissioning protocol date (datum vyhotovení protokolu o zařazení) The date the protocol was made out. Empty: the protocol shows the day it is printed; fill it in so that a reprint stays the same.
Vyřazení Disposal method (způsob vyřazení) Sale (prodej), liquidation (likvidace), donation or other gratuitous transfer (dar nebo jiný bezúplatný převod), contribution to another business corporation (vklad do jiné obchodní korporace), transfer under legal regulations (převod na základě právních předpisů), damage or shortage (škoda nebo manko), transfer from business to personal use (převod z podnikání do osobního užívání), other.
Disposal reason (důvod vyřazení) Free text.
Disposal protocol date (datum vyhotovení protokolu o vyřazení) As for the commissioning protocol.

The disposal method is recorded for the protocol only. It does not dispose of the asset or post anything; do that with the register's own disposal function.

Printing

From the asset, Print:

Both protocols open with the designation of the document — ZP- (zařazení) or VP- (vyřazení) followed by the inventory number — the date it was made out, and the company's name, seat and IČO.

  • Protokol o zařazení majetku — date put into use, asset name, inventory number, ocenění (pořizovací cena), účetní odpisový plán (the asset profile or model), místo umístění, odpovědná osoba, the commissioning note, and signature lines Majetek předal / Majetek převzal.
  • Protokol o vyřazení majetku — disposal date, asset name, inventory number, date put into use, ocenění (pořizovací cena), oprávky, zůstatková cena, způsob and důvod vyřazení, a note that the documents evidencing the disposal are an integral part of the protocol, and signature lines Vyřazení navrhl / Vyřazení schválil.

Both end with the two signature lines of § 11 odst. 1 písm. f): Osoba odpovědná za účetní případ and Osoba odpovědná za zaúčtování.

Where account_asset_tax is installed and the asset has tax depreciation switched on with a Czech depreciation group, the commissioning protocol adds two rows: Odpisová skupina (daňové odpisy) and Způsob daňového odpisování (rovnoměrné, zrychlené or mimořádné). Without that module the rows are left out.

The figures always add up: ocenění − oprávky = zůstatková cena, the net book value including any residual value the plan leaves undepreciated. Oprávky are the posted depreciation only; on the disposal protocol of a disposed asset they do not include the residual value written off, which is the zůstatková cena.

The printouts are in Czech whatever the user's language, the disposal method included; dates follow the user's date format. Both can be printed at any time; the disposal protocol of an asset that has not been disposed of simply has no disposal date.

Community: OCA asset register

l10n_cz_asset_protocol_oca installs itself when this module and OCA account_asset_management are both installed. Assets are under Accounting → Assets → Assets (the OCA menu). The protocols take:

On the protocol From the OCA asset
Datum uvedení do užívání Asset Start Date
Ocenění (pořizovací cena) Purchase Value
Oprávky the posted depreciation lines (not the removal line)
Zůstatková cena Purchase Value − oprávky (salvage value included)
Účetní odpisový plán Asset Profile
Datum vyřazení Asset Removal Date, set by the register's removal wizard
Inventární číslo, if empty Reference

Enterprise: Odoo asset register

l10n_cz_asset_protocol_ee installs itself when this module and Enterprise account_asset are both installed. Assets are under Accounting → Accounting → Assets & Liabilities → Assets. The protocols take:

On the protocol From the Enterprise asset
Datum uvedení do užívání Acquisition Date
Ocenění (pořizovací cena) Original Value of the asset and of its value increases (child assets)
Oprávky posted depreciation entries of the asset and its value increases, plus depreciation imported as already done; not the disposal or sale entry
Zůstatková cena ocenění − oprávky (salvage value included)
Účetní odpisový plán Asset Model
Datum vyřazení Disposal Date, set when the asset is disposed of or sold
Inventární číslo, if empty the asset's name

The two bridges cannot be installed together, because the two registers exclude each other.

Limitations

  • The designation of the document is derived from the inventory number (or the register's own reference); Odoo does not check that inventory numbers are unique.
  • The row is labelled Ocenění (pořizovací cena) whatever the valuation basis; for an asset valued at reprodukční pořizovací cena or vlastní náklady adapt the template.
  • The date put into use is the register's start or acquisition date; the protocols do not keep a separate date of acquisition.
  • The protocols do not print the tax entry price (vstupní cena) or the tax residual value; those are kept by account_asset_tax.
  • Responsible person is any contact; nothing ties it to an employee or to the hmotně odpovědná osoba of an inventory count.
  • The signature lines are for handwritten signatures; the module does not create electronic signature records.

Legislation referenced on this page

  • Zákon č. 563/1991 Sb., o účetnictví
  • Vyhláška č. 500/2002 Sb., kterou se provádějí některá ustanovení zákona č. 563/1991 Sb., o účetnictví, ve znění pozdějších předpisů, pro účetní jednotky, které jsou podnikateli účtujícími v soustavě podvojného účetnictví
  • Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů
